policy: Release certification is earned from ordered evidence. Static source signals and legacy scores never certify a game.

scenarios: Start from the Korean route and steer left and right while auto-fire advances score and wave feedback.
Survive through three hits and confirm the debrief names the last damage cause, kill count, score, and personal best.
Retry the same sector, observe the PB ghost cue, pause and continue immediately, then mute audio.
findings: No horizontal overflow at 390px; the canvas, HUD, controls, and debrief remain inside the viewport.
Production preview held 60 FPS during the sampled run and emitted no console warnings or errors.
The first run ended quickly without active steering, but the explicit missed-enemy cause and same-sector retry make the failure actionable.

craftReview.note: The mobile loop communicates movement, auto-fire, damage cause, PB ghost, and same-seed retry clearly; weapon upgrades and deterministic replay add depth beyond a disposable shooter skin.

scenarios: Reset the Korean route and use repeated canvas taps to jump until the first run ends with a personal best and a concrete next-score target.
Retry the same course and confirm the PB ghost cue appears while score, pace, and controls remain readable during play.
Pause mid-run, mute audio, reload the page, and confirm the paused run score and personal best restore without horizontal overflow.
findings: The first sampled run reached score 54 in five seconds, then presented the personal best, survival time, pace, next target, same-course retry, and new-course choice together.
Same-course retry exposed the PB ghost cue immediately; pausing at score 21 and reloading restored the paused state, score 21, and best score 54.
The 390px production preview reported innerWidth 390 and scrollWidth 375 with no console warnings or errors.

craftReview.note: The one-tap runner makes failure actionable through a next-score target, same-seed retry, deterministic PB ghost, rising pace, and resumable local state while keeping the mobile interaction immediately legible.

scenarios: Switch from the daily board to a fresh beginner board, reveal the top-left cell, and confirm the first move is safe and advances the onboarding guidance.
Request a logic hint and confirm it explains the deduction, reports the candidate count, and records that assistance was used.
Enter mobile flag mode, flag a closed cell, reload the page, and confirm the revealed board, flag, hint history, and active game restore.
findings: The sampled first click safely opened 72 of 100 beginner cells and advanced the three-step onboarding instead of risking an immediate mine.
The hint stated that the remaining closed-cell and mine counts forced a mine and highlighted one candidate, separating a logical deduction from a guess.
At 390px the restored board retained the flagged cell, revealed cells, and hint-use marker; innerWidth was 390, scrollWidth 375, and console warnings/errors were zero.

craftReview.note: Verified no-guess boards, first-click safety, explainable deductions, assistance-aware records, progressive onboarding, and durable mobile board state turn the familiar ruleset into a trustworthy mastery puzzle rather than a luck-driven clone.

scenarios: Switch the Korean route from local play to AI play and confirm Apprentice, Adept, and Master expose distinct search-depth and time budgets.
Play e4 against the Adept AI, wait for its Nf6 reply, and confirm both moves appear in notation and last-move feedback.
Flip the board, reload the page, and confirm AI mode, Adept difficulty, move history, last move, and black-side orientation restore.
findings: Adept answered e4 with Nf6 and the move-history region exposed both half-moves as readable notation rather than relying on board position alone.
Reload restored the saved game message, AI mode, Adept difficulty, e4/Nf6 history, Nf6 last-move label, and flipped orientation with H1 first.
Master clearly advertised a maximum 6-ply, 800ms budget; at 390px innerWidth was 390, scrollWidth 375, and console warnings/errors were zero.

craftReview.note: Explicit AI search budgets, complete legal-rule tests, notation and material tracking, durable orientation and game state, keyboard semantics, and a tested loss-review selector make the compact board useful for deliberate practice rather than opaque casual play.

scenarios: Play a Korean S17 round from hard 14 against a dealer 6 and compare the contextual stand recommendation with its risk explanation.
Stand and confirm the result names the exact dealer-total cause, selected action, cards drawn, deck remainder, next goal, and updated record.
Start another live hand, pause it, reload, and confirm the paused hand and record restore with hit and stand unavailable.
findings: The live guide recommended standing against the weak dealer up-card and explained the bust-risk tradeoff before the decision.
The sampled loss reported dealer hard 17 versus player hard 14, the stand action trail, zero cards drawn, 47 cards remaining, and the next record goal.
Reload restored a hard-19 hand in paused state with the explicit restored-round message; at 390px innerWidth was 390 and scrollWidth 375.

craftReview.note: S17 rules, hand-aware risk guidance, explicit result causes and action trails, deck context, record goals, and resumable deterministic hands make each short round teach a decision instead of merely revealing a random outcome.

scenarios: Start the Korean ramen stand with seed s10, raise noodle stock and price, choose a rich recipe, and open for a one-day result.
Review the resulting income statement and balance sheet, including revenue, COGS, gross profit, waste, overhead, depreciation, profit, cash, assets, debt, and equity.
Run the same seeded stand over the one-week horizon and confirm the aggregate day-8 summary remains readable at 390px.
findings: The adjusted one-day run sold six servings and separated $30.00 revenue, $7.50 COGS, $4.90 waste, $0.50 depreciation, $17.10 profit, and $117.60 cash.
The ledger explicitly warns that profit and cash are different lines and explains why depreciation lowers profit without spending cash; the balance sheet reconciled assets and equity.
The seeded one-week run summarized 84 sales, $336.00 revenue, $242.50 profit, and $346.00 cash; at 390px innerWidth was 390 and scrollWidth 375.

craftReview.note: Seeded weather and events, stock, recipe and pricing choices, multiple horizons, and a reconciled ledger that distinguishes profit from cash turn a compact stand simulation into an explainable operating-decision exercise.

scenarios: Enter five Korean guesses spanning cold to very hot similarity bands and confirm rank, temperature, and progress feedback order the search.
Open the first fair hint at guess five, confirm it reveals only the two-character answer length and announces the next hint at guess twelve, then reload.
Confirm all five guesses restore, solve with the sixth guess, and verify the result, streak, play count, sharing action, and next-puzzle countdown.
findings: The sampled trail moved from 컴퓨터 rank 36 through 하늘 26, 섬 11, 해변 5, and 파도 2 with distinct ice-to-very-hot labels.
The five-guess hint disclosed only answer length and preserved the twelve-guess gate; reload restored the five guesses and their ranked feedback.
바다 solved the demo on guess six, producing streak 1, best streak 1, one played puzzle, a share action, and a visible next-puzzle countdown; innerWidth was 390 and scrollWidth 375.

craftReview.note: Ordered semantic bands, deliberately gated non-answer hints, durable daily guesses, streak and next-puzzle return cues, and transparent handcrafted-data disclosure make the word search fair, legible, and repeatable.

scenarios: Start the Korean WebGL flight and confirm the live HUD exposes airspeed, altitude, vertical speed, heading, throttle, fuel, gates, time, and a three-step input tutorial.
Switch from chase to cockpit view, mute flight audio, and confirm both controls reflect their new states during the same run.
End the flight manually, inspect its score, gate and distance log plus actionable next-flight review, then reload and confirm the personal best persists.
findings: The production scene initialized at 159 knots, 2,034 feet, 62% throttle, full fuel, zero of five gates, and an explicit first-step throttle prompt without falling back from WebGL.
Cockpit switching changed the control to the chase-view action and muting changed the accessible audio label to off during live rendering.

The sampled flight logged score 817, zero gates, five kilometers, and the concrete recommendation to establish the first gate line; score 817 survived reload and the 390px page reported scrollWidth 375.

craftReview.note: A tested aerodynamic model, progressive input tutorial, cockpit and chase views, optional audio, persistent best score, and result-specific next-flight advice give the short WebGL flight a clear learning and retry loop.
